cachePromotionRegression.outcome: PASS; four deterministic plugin-free regressions using the real CacheManager public Config seams and engine image decoding; eight affected promotion/disposal tests passed together.
cachePromotionRegression.causeEvidence: flutter_cache_manager 3.4.1 CacheManager.putFile reuses an existing relativePath and writesAsBytes; old rememberValidated always re-read transferKey even when getFileStream delivered an immutable hit. Multiple visible rows can therefore rewrite one shared file during decoder reads or replace it with bytes not actually decoded. The initial native iPad run reported Invalid image data at ImageLoader/MultiImageStreamCompleter; root independently verified the failing GCS JPEG as valid.
cachePromotionRegression.fix: Record only the actual fresh delivered FileInfo, coalesce promotion per immutable identity, never rewrite an existing shared file, and decline new promotion at close while draining existing promotion and its asynchronous package metadata write before emptying storage. Warm-hit retry evicts only the same file actually used by the failed attempt.
cachePromotionRegression.bounds: Existing native CacheManager remains at 80 entries / 10 minutes; provenance maps each bounded at 80. No package fork/source changes or cache clearing/sleep workaround.
